summary: Bussel Realty Corp (BRC) is an independent New Jersey industrial/office/retail brokerage founded in 1984 by Steve Bussel, grown from a two-person shop to a roughly 20-person firm whose only published office is 2 Ethel Road, Suite 202A, Edison NJ - the 'New Brunswick NJ' pages are keyword service-area landing pages, not a second office. It represents industrial and office tenants, landlords, owners and investors across Central and North Jersey, says it handles over three million square feet annually, and claims a leading share of Central NJ industrial deal volume. Front desk is a single main line (732-287-3777) plus direct mobiles for 23 brokers; the site has no enquiry form, no booking, no structured data and a listing search that only renders through JavaScript.

facts.fact: Founded in 1984 by Steve Bussel; grew from a two-person shop to a 20-person brokerage; Steve still directs day-to-day brokerage, marketing, research and operations.
Only published address: 2 Ethel Road, Suite 202A, Edison NJ 08817; main line 732-287-3777; info@bussel.com.
The New Brunswick page is an 'Office Property, New Brunswick NJ' landing page carrying the Edison address plus a full broker directory - no New Brunswick office exists.
Employee directory lists 23 brokers plus one office contact (Cynthia Colon, x223), each broker with a direct mobile and email; Steve Bussel and Gregory Irving hold SIOR designations.

Firm states it handles over three million square feet of corporate and industrial properties annually in New Jersey and has held one of the largest Central NJ market shares by annual industrial deal volume for years.
Careers page lists only 'Real Estate Brokers' as open, including candidates with no prior experience whom the firm will train and mentor, on commission splits.

Indeed company page: 4.0/5 from one employee review (broker, October 2024) describing a slow pace and limited growth support; an active Marketing / Administrative Assistant posting in Edison at $42,000-$50,000/yr covering brochures, flyers, research, social media, branding and press announcements.
LinkedIn lists company size 11-50 employees and founding year 1984.

Steve Bussel, SIOR is described as president of BRC and Gregory Irving, SIOR as executive vice president in the firm's own release; BRC's clients 'have included several of the largest Fortune 500 Companies' per the About boilerplate.
The public listing template prints 'OPEN LISTING' and '[-address on file-]' instead of a street address, with pricing, dimensions and the exclusive broker's mobile.
The exclusives/search results page ships a placeholder template ('Data Loading...', lorem ipsum body, 'Type:industrial Available:0,000 sf') with listings injected by JavaScript.

2026 deal flow includes a 158,641 sq ft lease expansion at 60 Leonard Street, Metuchen (Stephen Izzi Trucking), 123,766 sq ft of renewals at 1580 Lower Road, Linden, and a $21.7M sale plus follow-on leasing campaign at 1200 Springfield Road, Union.

operations_signals: No enquiry, requirement or quote form and no online booking anywhere: the contact page is a broker directory, a main phone number and an email link, so every inbound tenant/landlord lead arrives by a call or one broker's inbox (https://bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj)
Phone numbers are plain text, not tel: links (header and footer print 732-287-3777 as text), so click-to-call does not work on a phone (https://bussel.com/)

Public listings hide the street address ('[-address on file-]'), so a prospective tenant must call a named broker to learn where a building is - a built-in manual step per enquiry (https://bussel.com/listing/23253)

Listing search and the exclusives page are JavaScript-fed from an old ASP system; the server-rendered page is a placeholder, so nobody without a browser (including a search crawler or agent) sees inventory (https://bussel.com/property-result.asp)

One main line plus 23 direct broker mobiles and a single admin extension; no after-hours coverage, voicemail routing or auto-reply path is published (https://bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj)

'What Is Your Property Worth?' opens an iframe form (whatismypropertyworth.asp) for free opinion-of-value requests - the only structured capture on the site, and it is seller-side only (https://bussel.com/)
Contact and public pages also carry a username/password CRM login (/login.asp) with a forgotten-password flow, so CRM is broker-side and separate from the public site (https://bussel.com/)
hiring_signals: Open: Marketing / Administrative Assistant, Edison NJ, full-time, $42,000-$50,000 - brochures and flyers, research and content creation, social media, branding, press announcements: a manual marketing/admin workload (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)

Own careers page advertises only Real Estate Brokers, wiliness to train no-experience hires - growth is via commission sales headcount, not support, research or ops roles (https://bussel.com/careers/commercial-real-estate/edison-nj/)
No postings found for intake, dispatch, AR/billing, research analyst or listing coordinator roles in this cycle (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)
Only one Indeed employee review on record (4.0/5, broker, Oct 2024), so hiring volume and staff sentiment cannot be inferred from review data (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)
review_themes: No customer review corpus could be sourced on Indeed, Google or Clutch; Clutch lists the firm as 'not yet reviewed' and the only employee review is a single 2024 entry (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)
The lone employee review calls the pace slow, colleagues pleasant, and support/growth help thin - a mild signal of an under-resourced back office (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)

Client praise exists only as firm-published testimonial material (e.g. a president quoted about a relocation handled by Jordan Metz), not as independent reviews - so reputational evidence is self-reported (https://bussel.com/)
No public complaints about responsiveness, billing errors or scheduling were found - absence of evidence, not evidence of smooth service (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)
tech_footprint: Classic ASP/IIS stack with duplicate legacy URL trees (/default.asp, /history.asp vs /default/commercial-real-estate/central-new-jersey), jQuery 1.11.2 (2014-era) and a raw IIS error page exposing server paths (https://bussel.com/)

Analytics is Google Universal Analytics UA-19665552-1 (a retired property) plus a third-party 'AgenciSonar' tracker, and Font Awesome's hosted kit - i.e. no modern tag management or consent layer (https://bussel.com/)
No JSON-LD/structured data on the home page raw HTML and no tel: links, so local/real-estate schema and click-to-call are both missing (https://bussel.com/)

Listings are served by a JavaScript-driven property search over an in-house database, with a separate CRM login for brokers and no client portal or document room (https://bussel.com/property-search.asp)

An earlier browser review reported a hidden injected spam block on the home page; the raw HTML I fetched on 2026-11-13 contained no such block and no gambling/passport links, so either it was cleaned up or it is served conditionally - unverified either way (https://bussel.com/)
Content marketing exists (news, transactions, quarterly-report categories plus LinkedIn deal posts) but the category pages render empty in static HTML (https://bussel.com/news.asp?c=Quarterly_Report)
growth_signals: Heavy 2026 release cadence: 158,641 sq ft Izzi Trucking expansion in Metuchen, 123,766 sq ft of renewals at 1580 Lower Road in Linden, a 30,283 sq ft lease in Carlstadt, and a $21.7M Union sale with a follow-on leasing campaign (https://bussel.com/news-detail.asp?id=212)

A named sub-team, 'Metz Industrial Group (MIG) of Bussel Realty Corp', now issues its own releases under the BRC banner - team-level expansion inside the firm (https://bussel.com/news-detail.asp?id=262)
Recruiting both experienced and no-experience brokers with mentoring and commission-split pitches points to planned headcount growth (https://bussel.com/careers/commercial-real-estate/edison-nj/)

Firm claims largest independent industrial brokerage in New Jersey and top industrial deal volume in Middlesex, Somerset and Union counties (https://bussel.com/careers/commercial-real-estate/edison-nj/)
Marketing hire (assistant, $42-50k) suggests investment in brand/press output rather than in operations or technology (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp)
physical_signals: One office: Suite 202A at 2 Ethel Road, Edison NJ 08817, a multi-tenant office building - no warehouse, yard or fleet of its own is published (https://bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj)

No square footage or seat count for the Edison suite is stated by any source; the 'New Brunswick' location in this record has no physical presence (https://bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj)

The footprint that matters is the portfolio it markets: an open listing of 374,250 sq ft available (divisible from 37,250 sq ft) in a 650,000 sq ft industrial building in Paterson on 16.6 acres with 39 tailboards (https://bussel.com/listing/23253)

Landlord-side assignments it publicises include a 158,641 sq ft Metuchen industrial building with 20 tailboards, ~7,000 sq ft of offices and ESFR sprinklers on 7.5 acres, and a 124,618 sq ft Class A Linden property built in 2019 (https://bussel.com/news-detail.asp?id=212)

Team size is roughly 24 people (23 brokers plus one admin) in a single suite - a desk-based brokerage with no field or yard operations of its own (https://bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj)
decision_maker: Steve Bussel, SIOR - President / Founder, named on the firm's own history page and quoted as 'president of BRC' in its release (https://bussel.com/history/real-estate-brokerage/edison-nj/); day-to-day number two is Gregory Irving, SIOR, Executive Vice President (https://bussel.com/news-detail.asp?id=212)

inferences.inference: Inbound tenant/landlord interest is hand-dispatched by whoever answers the main line or a broker mobile, and nothing structured (property type, size, budget, timeline) is captured at first contact.
inferences.reasoning: The only contact path on the New Brunswick/office pages is 23 broker mobiles plus one reception extension and info@ email; no form, booking or intake field exists on the site.

inferences.inference: A material share of enquiries is likely lost after hours and during showings, and response speed depends on individual brokers rather than a process.
inferences.reasoning: Mobile-first contact with no after-hours routing, auto-reply or central intake published, and listings deliberately withhold addresses so a call is required.

inferences.inference: Listing data and market research sit in an in-house database maintained by hand, so flyers, brochures, market reports and listing updates consume broker and admin hours.
inferences.reasoning: History page describes in-house research/operations staff feeding brokers from an 'extensive database'; the open Marketing/Admin role is largely flyer, research and content production; listings require manual ASP entry.

inferences.inference: The firm is effectively invisible to search engines and AI agents for its own inventory and cannot be quoted reliably as a local New Brunswick business.
inferences.reasoning: Search results are JS-only placeholders in static HTML, there is no schema markup, no meta-description-driven location data, and the New Brunswick pages are duplicated keyword landing pages with an Edison address.

inferences.inference: Reputation management is not practiced, which caps inbound lead volume for a firm of this deal volume.
inferences.reasoning: No independent customer reviews found on Clutch, Indeed or elsewhere; only firm-published testimonials, and no review-request or profile-management presence visible on the site.

data_gaps: Google Business Profile could not be verified in this session - Maps is JavaScript-rendered and all fetch attempts failed. The triage record's checker reports a 'Bussel Realty Corporation' profile at 2 Ethel Rd #202a, Edison at 4.5 with an open-to-4 PM listing and (732) 287-3777 but no review count; treat rating and review volume as unconfirmed.
Indeed returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; the 4.0/5 employee review and the Marketing/Admin Assistant posting details come from search-engine extracts of that page, not a page I opened.
Glassdoor, Clutch, re-nj.com and njbiz.com tag pages were blocked (403) - no further employee or client reviews read.
The hidden-spam injection reported in the triage record did not appear in the raw home page HTML fetched today; could not confirm whether it was removed or is served conditionally.
No published revenue, headcount, square footage of the Edison suite, client list, or CRM/vendor names.
No written content behind the 'Quarterly Report' news category rendered in static HTML, so market-report output could not be assessed.
